verdict.rationale: The QuickBooks Workforce API is documented as a GraphQL API with a 'schema' section, which could serve as a machine-readable spec equivalent. However, probes of every standard OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and nothing shows the schema can be downloaded as a file. missing for 10: a confirmed downloadable OpenAPI or GraphQL schema file (SDL/introspection), documented download location, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Build payroll tools with the QuickBooks Workforce API -- schema, GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks, samples, and publishing.
